svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lumen group chat architecture
svg.desc: Left to right: the React browser client sends messages and stops to a Hono API as idempotent POSTs. The API appends each user message to an append-only SQLite event log through a single writer that assigns a gap-free seq, then hands every message to steering. Steering resolves @Name targets and bare stops with a regex, asks an LLM classifier whether a message is a steer or a new message, and aborts and restarts a targeted agent's segment. New messages start a turn in the orchestrator, where each agent bids from its own private notes, duplicates are dropped and replies stream in waves within message and hop budgets. Models are resolved from env strings by the Vercel AI SDK registry: OpenAI gpt-5.6-luna, or a scripted fake for tests. Token deltas are appended to the log and streamed back to the browser over resumable SSE ordered by seq. A tests band shows unit, integration, property, end-to-end and real-model eval layers.
svg.text: One person, three agents, one conversation — steerable mid-sentence, ordered by construction.
Same code, scripted or real models
every message goes to steering after it is appended
